title: Canonical internal integral-to-rational continuous coefficient inclusion
statement: Let $\ell$ be a prime and let $E$ be a finite normed extension of $\mathbf Q_\ell$, with its extended norm and valuation ring $A=\mathcal O_E$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. Let $X$ be a scheme in universe $u$, with its small pro-etale site [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site]. For $R=A,E$, write $R_X^c=p_X^*\underline R$ for the pulled continuous condensed ring [sk-def-sfb-pulled-back-coefficients], using the continuous ring objects and their induced commutative ring structures [def-weil-pbc-condensed-e-module-category]. Let $\chi_R:R_X^c\to C(|-|,R)$ be the canonical condensed-to-continuous ring chart [def-sfb-continuous-ring-canonical-comparison]. Define the internal coefficient inclusion $\varphi_X:A_X^c\to E_X^c$ to be the composite $\chi_A$, followed by the actual continuous coefficient inclusion $C(|-|,A)\to C(|-|,E)$ given on every site object by postcomposition with $A\hookrightarrow E$, followed by $\chi_E^{-1}$. The inverse exists because the extended norm is ultrametric and $E$ is totally disconnected. The resulting map is a morphism of the specified internal commutative ring objects: it preserves multiplication and unit. No noetherianity, finite-type, constructibility, module or nonemptiness hypothesis is imposed.

def continuousInternalScalarMapUniverses (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime]
    (E : Type u) [NormedField E] [NormedAlgebra ℚ_[l] E]
    [FiniteDimensional ℚ_[l] E] (T : Scheme.{u}) :
    condensedRingObj (Profinite.continuousCoefficientRingObj
      (Padic.coefficientExtensionIntegers l E)) T ⟶
      condensedRingObj (Profinite.continuousCoefficientRingObj E) T
